[{"id":"mjskbfb7efkl8cpkexi","text":"I am writing to express my interest in the [Role Title] position with [Role Title] in the Beenleigh region. I am passionate about supporting people with disability to build confidence, independence, and meaningful connections within their community, and I am excited by the opportunity to contribute to [Company Name]’s person-centred, capacity-building approach."},{"id":"mjskbwqt5ys5m5dv38","text":"Alongside my professional experience in disability support, I bring over 25 years of lived experience supporting my son, who has Down Syndrome. This long-term, hands-on experience has given me a deep, practical understanding of disability across the lifespan, including advocacy, daily support needs, capacity building, navigating systems, and the importance of dignity, choice, and genuine inclusion.
